remaining_cohort_cpu_script:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=panda-cohort-cpu
#SBATCH --account=bfqi-delta-cpu
#SBATCH --qos=bfqi-delta-cpu
#SBATCH --partition=cpu-interactive
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --chdir=/work/nvme/bfqi/mhoda
#SBATCH --output=/work/nvme/bfqi/mhoda/panda-cohort-cpu-%j.out
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
module load pytorch-conda/2.8
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTHONPATH=/u/mhoda/floater-finder/releases/panda-cohort-audit-20261020-v1/source/src
pids=()
for worker in 0 1 2 3; do
  (
    for ((start=10+worker*10; start<120; start+=40)); do
      srun --exclusive --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=1 --mem=4G /work/nvme/bfqi/mhoda/floater-finder/envs/panda-cpu-1598f9b-20261020T040441Z/bin/python /u/mhoda/floater-finder/releases/panda-cohort-audit-20261020-v1/source/scripts/panda_tile_cohort.py         --root /work/nvme/bfqi/mhoda/panda --manifest /work/nvme/bfqi/mhoda/panda/cohort-plans/20261020-scale-v1/candidate_120.csv --output /work/nvme/bfqi/mhoda/floater-finder/panda-cohort-tiles/120-v1-representative --start "$start" --count 10
    done
  ) &
  pids+=("$!")
done
status=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || status=1; done
exit "$status"
